title: repeat_extra
description: Staged-emitter repeat regressions beyond the official repeat.json suite, which never reads more than one choice type at once, whose repeat+internal-fork cases all expect a single row (so cannot expose a per-node cross-product), and which has no array-navigating column directly in a repeat scope. Uses per-test `resources` (a custom-suite extension) so each regression carries its own data.

tests.title: choice-type ofType() forEach inside repeat (typed bridge)
tests.description: A forEach inside a repeat region whose columns use value.ofType(<type>) must re-establish typed evaluation off the from_json bridge element: value.ofType(string) -> el.valueString, value.ofType(integer) -> el.valueInteger. Each answer binds the matching choice type; the other is NULL.

tests.title: two forEach siblings inside a repeat recombine per node (fork inside repeat)
tests.description: Regression for FORK-inside-a-repeat-body: the descent CTE must carry a per-node identity into the fork key, else sibling forks recombine across ALL nodes of the resource instead of per node. Per node the two forEach:answer siblings cross-product: item 'a' (2 answers) -> 4 rows, item 'b' (1 answer) -> 1 row; v1/v2 always belong to the same item.

tests.title: collection column navigating an array inside repeat (lambda collision)
tests.description: Regression for REPEAT_LAMBDA_COLLISION_BUG: a column directly in a repeat scope whose path navigates through an array (answer.value.ofType(string)) compiles to list_transform(el -> ...). The lambda parameter must not collide with the repeat bridge element (also `el`), else el.valueString binds to the bridge struct and raises 'Could not find key valuestring'.
